title: Paper v2 should own event_signal platform capability instead of StrategyPackage runtime_config
description:
Expected: `event_signal` should be represented as a platform capability owned by the Paper v2 / simulation runtime boundary, while StrategyPackage runtime config stays limited to strategy semantics, adapter-neutral hashes, and reusable execution contract fields. Current-phase isolation tests should pass without needing a whitelist exception for `backend/services/strategy_package`.
Actual: `backend/services/strategy_package/runtime_config.py` currently defines `PlatformSignalCapability` and nests it in `PlatformCapabilities` as `event_signals`, which leaks `event_signal` into StrategyPackage namespace and causes `backend/tests/test_unified_event_signal_schema.py::test_event_signal_is_not_consumed_by_trading_paths_in_current_phase` to fail.
reproduce_command: python -m pytest -q backend/tests/test_unified_event_signal_schema.py -p no:cacheprovider && rg -n "event_signal_enabled|event_signals|PlatformSignalCapability" backend/services/strategy_package backend/tests -S
required_verification: Document or test that event_signal platform capability is not owned by StrategyPackage runtime_config.
If a future consumer is needed, define it under Paper v2/platform runtime profile rather than StrategyPackage.
Verify no current Paper v2, Selection, QMT, or StrategyPackage runtime path consumes event_signal in this phase.
closure_requirements: Ownership decision is encoded in tests/docs so future event_signal consumption lands in Paper v2/platform layer.
BUG-061 concrete test failure is either fixed by removing reserved fields or superseded by a Paper v2-owned capability contract.
GitHub issue contains fix branch, validation evidence, and whether the chosen outcome was remove-now or rehome-later.

events.note: Recommendation: do not just whitelist the test. If there is no current consumer, delete the pre-reserved `event_signal` capability from StrategyPackage. If a future consumer is needed, reintroduce it in a Paper v2/platform config owned by the runtime consumer, not by StrategyPackage.

Ownership recommendation: let the Paper v2 team drive the boundary cleanup because this field affects the shared runtime contract for paper/simulation/miniQMT consumers, even though the current code smell appears in StrategyPackage.

Suggested outcome: keep StrategyPackage focused on strategy semantics and adapter-independent hashes; move any event-signal capability to a platform-layer config or remove it entirely until a real consumer exists.
This issue is separate from the legacy paper-trading cleanup and from any active event_signal generation work.
User confirmed #61 was input error and should be ignored. This bug remains in the queue as event_signal/StrategyPackage/Paper v2 ownership cleanup.
Mirrored to GitHub issue #71; user confirmed unrelated GitHub #61 is input error and ignored.
Started dedicated worktree/branch; platform-owned event_signal_policy modeled in runtime profile/backtest contract, while StrategyPackage runtime_config reserved fields are removed.
Combined validation passed: unified event-signal schema, StrategyPackage runtime/backtest contracts, and Paper v2 runtime profile tests (25 passed); py_compile and diff check passed.
